svg.text: Guide-cap, heel bracket and weld dimensions are proposals. Rubber remains an 80mm supplier envelope, requiring ≥22mm usable compression.
Foot/base welds: 6mm candidate. Bolster wall, rubber curve/creep, lateral loads and complete tolerance stack remain engineering holds.
